description:
### Release v3.14.0

- Added Custom Font & Modern Emoji injection patch (bypassing OEM/OnePlus system emoji censorship with smart content-aware fallback)
- Fixed standby battery drain and GoogleAsrService background leak
- Fixed Bitwarden/1Password inline autofill on renamed package
- Expanded multi-version reflection for Rambler on Gboard 18.0.3, 18.3.1, and 18.4.1
